name: Ornith-1.5 card misread across competitor columns
symptom: SWE-bench Verified recorded 74.2 and Terminal-Bench 2.1 56.4, plus an AIME 2026 96.7 row that does not exist on the card.
root_cause: The card's eval table is a leaderboard layout: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, Ornith-1.0, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Gemma-4-31B, Muse-Glimmer-30B, Qwen3.5-397B. Reading cells without binding them to that header picked up neighbouring models' values (74.2 belongs to Ornith-1.0-35B-A3B; AIME is absent from the table entirely).
workaround: Bind every cell read to the table's own header row and confirm the resolved column by checking that multiple known rows reproduce. verify_scores.py does this; run it after any score backfill.
notes: Corrected values read directly from column 1 of the card table on 2026-10-19: SWE-bench Verified 79, GPQA Diamond 89.2, Terminal-Bench 2.1 (Terminus-2) 67.8. AIME 2026 removed: neither the card nor config.json publishes an AIME row.
